tools.name: search_articles
tools.description: Search Credit Guru guides and news about credit cards, points and miles, bank bonuses and credit scores. Returns titles, summaries and links.

tools.name: list_current_offers
tools.description: Bank account bonuses and card welcome offers Credit Guru checked in the last 30 days: reward, requirements, fees, deadline, the catch and the official source.

tools.name: find_cards
tools.description: Filter the Credit Guru card catalog by type, annual fee, credit level and foreign fee. Returns issuer facts, our rating and review links, best rated first.

tools.name: get_card
tools.description: Full facts for one card by slug: fees, rewards, APRs, welcome offer, our rating breakdown, pros and cons, and the issuer source.

tools.name: get_best_cards
tools.description: A ranked Credit Guru best-of list, such as cash back, travel, balance transfer, business or cards for a credit level.

tools.name: list_calculators
tools.description: Credit Guru calculators and quizzes (debt payoff, balance transfer, utilization and more) with links.

tools.name: list_hotel_programs
tools.description: Hotel booking programs that come with cards (Amex Fine Hotels + Resorts and The Hotel Collection, Capital One Premier and Lifestyle Collection, The Edit by Chase): perks, which cards unlock them, how to book, FAQ and issuer sources.

tools.name: find_hotels
tools.description: Hotels Credit Guru checked on their own sites, with the card hotel programs whose official pages list them. Filter by city, country, brand or program; returns address, check-in times, programs and links.
